## 1. Repository Settings Screen

**File:** `src/pages/RepoSettings.tsx`

This is the main page component (`RepoSettingsPage`) that:
- Lists all repos in a table with feature-flag columns (Review, Vectors, Docs, Upgrade, Quality, Archived)
- Has a "Show archived" toggle in the header
- Clicking a row (or the "Add Repository" button) opens an inline `RepoEditor` panel

Key sub-components defined in the same file:

**`ToggleBadge`** (lines 145–157) — a read-only On/Off badge shown in the table:

```145:157:src/pages/RepoSettings.tsx
function ToggleBadge({ value }: { value: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span
      className={`text-xs font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-[var(--border-radius-tag)] ${
        value
          ? 'bg-[var(--color-tags-success-background)] text-[var(--color-tags-font-success)]'
          : 'bg-[var(--color-tags-neutral-background)] text-[var(--color-tags-font-neutral)]'
      }`}
    >
      {value ? 'On' : 'Off'}
    </span>
  )
}
```

---

## 2. Toggle/Switch Components

There are **two custom toggle implementations** in the codebase — no third-party toggle library is used.

### A. `Toggle` in `src/pages/RepoSettings.tsx` (lines 159–186)
A reusable interactive toggle used in the `RepoEditor` for boolean fields like `reviewEnabled`, `docsEnabled`, etc.:

```159:186:src/pages/RepoSettings.tsx
function Toggle({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string
  value: boolean
  onChange: (v: boolean) => void
}) {
  return (
    <label className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 cursor-pointer">
      <span className="text-sm text-[var(--color-fonts-font-color-primary)]">{label}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onChange(!value)}
        className={`relative w-10 h-5 rounded-full transition-colors ${
          value ? 'bg-[var(--color-buttons-button-primary)]' : 'bg-[var(--color-inputs-input-border)]'
        }`}
      >
        <span
          className={`absolute top-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform ${
            value ? 'translate-x-5' : 'translate-x-0.5'
          }`}
        />
      </button>
    </label>
  )
}
```

### B. Inline toggle in the `PageHeader` actions of `RepoSettingsPage` (lines 37–52)
An inline-only toggle for "Show archived" — same visual pattern but not extracted into a component:

```37:52:src/pages/RepoSettings.tsx
<label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none">
  <button
    type="button"
    onClick={() => setShowArchived((v) => !v)}
    className={`relative w-10 h-5 rounded-full transition-colors ${
      showArchived ? 'bg-[var(--color-buttons-button-primary)]' : 'bg-[var(--color-inputs-input-border)]'
    }`}
  >
    <span
      className={`absolute top-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform ${
        showArchived ? 'translate-x-5' : 'translate-x-0.5'
      }`}
    />
  </button>
  <span className="text-sm text-[var(--color-fonts-font-color-support)]">Show archived</span>
</label>
```

There is also a toggle-style enable/disable button in `src/pages/Hooks.tsx` (lines 86–98), though it uses a badge-style button rather than a pill-switch.

## 3. Dialog/Modal Components

There are **two inline modal components**, both following the same pattern: a fixed full-screen backdrop with a centered card, click-outside to close, and an X button.

### A. `MetricsDialog` in `src/pages/ReviewMetrics.tsx` (lines 148–218)
Displays review quality metrics for a selected repo in a `max-w-lg` modal:

```148:162:src/pages/ReviewMetrics.tsx
function MetricsDialog({ row, onClose }: { row: RowData; onClose: () => void }) {
  const { repo, metrics } = row

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
      style={{ background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)' }}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-[var(--color-cards-card-background)] border border-[var(--color-cards-card-stroke)] rounded-[var(--border-radius-card)] shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.24)]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
```

### B. `ReportDialog` in `src/pages/QualityReports.tsx` (lines 221–383)
A larger, scrollable (`max-w-2xl`, `max-h-[90vh]`) modal showing quality metrics, a `ScoreGauge` SVG chart, a `Line` trend chart, and a "Run Quality Report" action button:

```275:284:src/pages/QualityReports.tsx
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
      style={{ background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)' }}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="relative w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto bg-[var(--color-cards-card-background)] border border-[var(--color-cards-card-stroke)] rounded-[var(--border-radius-card)] shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.24)]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
```
